== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Merope''' has a solitary primary star known as ''Sisyphus''.
* It is a yellow main sequence.
 
{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Merope
|primary        = G3 V 
|PrimaryName    = Sisyphus
|PrimaryNotes   = 
}}

'''Note:''' The system's primary star is ''not'' the canonical B type late main sequence star ''[[Merope (star)|Merope]]'', though it is in the same local area of space and likely lends the world its name.

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]].
* x10 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
* x2 [[planetoid belt]]s.
* x3 [[gas giant]]s.

Braci, a secondary world orbiting in the outer part of the [[habitable zone]], features a few large mining camps located atop the most promising mineral deposits.

The stony Corinthian Belt, which marks the edge of the cold [[Outer World|outer system]], is the location of Boutak City, one of the system's main [[spaceport]]s and trade hubs.

=== Mainworld Data ===
'''Merope''' orbits within the prime region of its star's [[habitable zone]].

[[File:Chart Orbit HZ Region Detailed.png|600 px]]

[[File:Blank World Map Arid.png|500 px]] <br> (''Blank map, predominantly dry world''.)

==== Native Lifeforms ====
Abundant [[Lifeform|native life]] occupying every available ecological niche. Its metabolic functions drive the process of atmospheric renewal.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
[[File:Comp-Prog-Dav-R-Deitrick-Starter-Trav-Page-16 16-July-2018a.jpg|right]]
'''Merope''' is a member of the [[Palermo Cluster]], a small but important [[trade route]] lying close to the [[coreward]]-[[trailing]] edge of [[Aldebaran Sector]].

The [[mainworld]] itself is not very important, but the system as a whole is the center of the [[Palermo Cluster|Cluster's]] raw materials extraction industry.

=== [[Starport|World Starport]] (St) ===
{{Starport|name= Merope|Starport= D}}

=== [[Population|World Population]] (P) ===
{{WorldPop|name= Merope|multiplier= 2|Population= 7}}
* More than 90% of the population (in excess of 18 million individuals) is made up of [[Solomani]] humans.
* Less than 10% of the population (fewer than 2 million individuals) consists of [[Dolphin]]s.

[[File:Dolphin Liz Danforth 1980 JTAS06 p38.jpg|350 px|right]]

==== Urbanization ====
Small cities are dispersed around the globe; each has its own small [[spaceport]].

==== Linguistic Topography ====
The most commonly heard [[language]]s are:
* [[Delphinic Trinary]], the principal language of [[Dolphin]]s.
* [[Rim Anglic]], a dialect of [[Anglic]] and the principal language of the [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]].

=== [[Technology Level|World Technology Level]] (T) ===
{{WorldTech|name= Merope|WorldTech= 6}}

=== [[Government|World Government]] (G) ===
{{WorldGov|name= Merope|Government= A}}

There is some nationalist feeling among communities within the Merope system, mainly directed at gaining a higher proportion of the system's income. It is currently disorganized.

=== [[Law Level|World Law]] (L) ===
{{WorldLaw|name= Merope|Law= 7}}

==== World Timeline ====
Major events that have affected this world and the wider region that it lies within:

* [[-9235]]: far to [[coreward]], the [[Vilani]] discover [[jump drive]] technology. Over the centuries pioneers and settlers gradually spread across [[Charted Space]].
* [[-4045]] to [[-2204]]: the [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]] controls vast territories.
* [[-2431]]: [[Terran]]s discover [[jump drive]] technology.
* [[-2404]] to [[-2215]]: the [[Interstellar Wars]].
* [[-2204]] to [[-1776]]: the [[Rule of Man]] administers the former [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]].
* [[-1776]] to [[0]]: the [[Long Night]].
* [[0|The Year 0]]: to [[coreward]], the [[Third Imperium]] is founded.
* [[300]]-[[420]]: the {{Imperial}} [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[604]]-[[622]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Civil War]].
* [[624]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Express Boat Network]] is established.
* [[704]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is formed.
* [[800]]-[[820]]: the [[Psionics Suppressions]].
* [[871]]: the [[Solomani Confederation]] is founded.
* [[940]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is dissolved.
* [[990]]-[[1002]]: the [[Solomani Rim War]].
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Second Survey]] includes data for the system.
* [[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] is published. Information about the system becomes widely available.
